info.name: ourWKRP - API Reference
info.description:
White-label API reference for the ourWKRP Cloudflare Worker, organized by domain. Feeds OSM (OurSharedMagnets) white-label API documentation.

This is the documentation collection: every route, foldered, with descriptions and example requests. For the executable end-to-end smoke run see ourwkrp.postman_collection.json.

Conventions:
- base_url - set per environment (http://localhost:8787 for `wrangler dev`).
- Auth - session is an HttpOnly cookie `wkrp_session`. Obtain it from POST /auth/register (Set-Cookie) and send it back via the `Cookie` header; the {{session_cookie}} variable holds `wkrp_session=<token>`.
- Brand - brand_id is derived from the request host subdomain ({brand}.ourwkrp.com); localhost and the apex domain resolve to the default brand 'wkrp'.
- IDs - contributors, playlists, tracks, and sets are UUIDs. Fill the collection variables from earlier responses.

request.description: Liveness/version probe. No auth. Returns { ok, service, version, env, timestamp }.

item.name: Auth & Session
item.description: Registration, Spotify OAuth (Authorization Code + PKCE), and session lookup.

request.description: Create a contributor and session WITHOUT Spotify (the CSV-first path). `role` (dj|curator|contributor|listener) defaults to 'contributor'; `generation` (founder|gen2|gen3) defaults to 'founder'. Returns 201 with a `Set-Cookie: wkrp_session=...` header.
Begins the Spotify Authorization Code + PKCE flow: generates a PKCE verifier/challenge, stores state in KV (10 min TTL), and 302-redirects the browser to Spotify.
Spotify redirect target. Exchanges the authorization code for tokens, stores them in KV, creates a session, and redirects into the app. Invoked by the browser, not called directly.
Returns the contributor profile for the current session cookie (id, name, generation, role, brand_id). 401 if the cookie is missing or expired. Never returns Spotify tokens.
Clears the session from KV and returns a Set-Cookie that expires the browser cookie (Max-Age=0).

item.name: Catalog
item.description: Read-only catalog browse. No authentication required - anonymous browsing is supported.

request.description: Filtered, searchable, cursor-paginated track list. Query params: q (FTS5 search), genre, artist, contributor, layer (dj|crew|community), year_min, year_max, energy_min/max, valence_min/max, danceability_min/max, cursor, limit (1-100, default 25). Returns { ok, tracks, cursor, has_more }.
All active contributors in the brand, each with a track_count.
Full contributor profile: roles, track/playlist counts, top genres, contribution sources, playlists, and brands contributed to.
Cross-brand discovery: which brands this contributor has contributed tracks to, with per-brand track counts.
Catalog statistics: total tracks/contributors/playlists, top genres, top decades, has_audio_features.
Track counts per layer: dj (from DJ sets), crew (founders/curators), community (contributors/listeners), and all.
All brands (tenants) with contributor and track counts.

item.name: Playlists
item.description: Curated playlist builder. Creation requires a session whose role is founder, curator, or dj.

request.description: Create a curated playlist. Requires a session with role founder|curator|dj (403 otherwise). Returns 201 with the new playlist.
Get a playlist with its ordered tracks (by playlist UUID). If the id is a contributor UUID instead, returns that contributor's playlists.
Append tracks to a curated playlist you own. Body: { track_ids: string[] } (1-100 ids). Track position is assigned server-side.
Remove tracks from a curated playlist you own. Body: { track_ids: string[] }.
Export a playlist as JSON with ISRCs, for manual import into Apple Music or other platforms.

item.name: Import
item.description: Multi-platform CSV library import with provenance tracking.

body.raw: {"csv":"Track URI,Track Name,Artist Name(s),Album Name,ISRC\nspotify:track:4cOdK2wGLETKBW3PvgPWqT,Example Song,Example Artist,Example Album,USEX00000001","source_type":"liked","source_name":"Example Library"}

request.description: Import a music library CSV for a contributor. The session cookie must match :contributorId. Accepts application/json { csv, source_type?, source_name? }, raw text/csv, or multipart/form-data (file field). Exportify, Last.fm, and Apple Music formats are auto-detected; tracks are deduplicated by ISRC > platform id > canonical title+artist.

item.name: Spotify Sync
item.description: Legacy Spotify library sync (capped by the Spotify dev-mode 5-user limit).

request.description: Sync the user's Spotify library (playlists -> tracks -> audio features) into D1. Requires a Spotify-authenticated session for :userId.

item.name: DJ Attribution
item.description: Live DJ sets and discovery attribution - the provenance chain crediting the DJ who introduced a track.

request.description: Start a live DJ set for the authenticated DJ. Body: { venue_name?, event_id? }.
Append a track to a live set as the DJ plays it.
End a live set (marks it no longer live).
Record a discovery attribution: a listener discovered a track via a DJ. Body: { dj_id, track_id, event_id? }.
Influence stats for a DJ: attributions, tracks introduced, reach.
The DJ's current live set as JSON (tracks played so far).

item.name: Last.fm
item.description: Last.fm integration - auth, scrobble sync, and connection status.

request.description: Redirect the browser to Last.fm's auth page.
Last.fm redirect target. Exchanges the token for a session key.
Sync the user's Last.fm scrobble history and tags into the catalog.
Whether a user has a connected Last.fm account.

item.name: Reporting & Integration
item.description: Catalog export and cross-product (OurSharedEvents) integration endpoints.

request.description: Export the full catalog. Requires a curator/founder session. format=json (default) or format=csv.
Sponsor reporting for an event: reach and music attributed during sponsored sets.
Music played at an OurSharedEvents event - the cross-product integration point between ourWKRP and OSE.
